svg.title: The common quotient of the relation supports
svg.desc: The relation carrier M maps surjectively to B by a and to G by b-prime. B maps down to B by its identity, G maps down to G/A by q_A, and beta maps B to G/A across the bottom. The diagram commutes: beta composed with a equals q_A composed with b-prime. Here a(b,y) = b, b-prime(b,y) = y, and beta(b) = b+A.
